_about: Public-domain Charles Henry Brent, Episcopal missionary Bishop of the Philippine Islands and then Bishop of Western New York, for the Word Hoard: With God in the World, The Splendor of the Human Body, The Consolations of the Cross, Adventure for God, With God in Prayer, The Mind of Christ Jesus in the Church of the Living God, Leadership, The Sixth Sense, Presence, The Revelation of Discovery, Prisoners of Hope, The Inspiration of Responsibility, The Master Builder, The Conquest of Trouble, The Mount of Vision, Soldiers of the Wooden Cross, and Understanding. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 129 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

brent-leadership: Leadership; the William Belden Noble lectures delivered at Sanders theatre, Harvard university, December, 1907 (New York [etc.] Longmans, Green, and co., 1908)

brent-master-builder: A master builder, being the life and letters of Henry Yates Satterlee, first bishop of Washington (New York, London [etc.] Longmans, Green and Co., 1916)
brent-conquest-of-trouble: The conquest of trouble and The peace of God (Philadelphia, G. W. Jacobs & company, 1916)
